from object_detector_tool import ObjectDetectorTool

def count_people_in_purple():
    # Load image
    image_path = "/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_4_image_1.jpg"
    image_data = Image.open(image_path)

    # Detect objects using DINO model
    detection = ObjectDetectorTool.execute(image=image_data)

    # Check if any purple object has been detected
    people_with_purple = []

    for obj in detection:
        if obj['label'] == "Purple Coat" and obj['confidence score'] > 0.1:
            people_with_purple.append(obj)

    # Count people using detected purple object labels
    num_people_in_purple = len(people_with_purple)

    return num_people_in_purple
</command>
